source.snippet: Please stop flooding our projects with AI slop to furnish your CV. OSS maintainers are spending significant uncompensated time reviewing and rejecting low-quality AI-generated pull requests submitted by people trying to pad their GitHub contribution history.

problem_statement: Open source project maintainers are overwhelmed by a surge of AI-generated low-quality pull requests, wasting hours of review time per week and degrading contributor community health — with no automated tooling to detect or filter AI-slop contributions before they enter the review queue.
target_segment: Maintainers of mid-to-large open source projects, especially those backed by companies or foundations with paid engineering staff reviewing contributions.
notes: Pain is real and recent (2026, score 8 on Lobsters). Time waste is the core cost — maintainers describe this as an ongoing burden. Paying buyer would be companies sponsoring OSS projects or platform hosts (GitHub, GitLab) rather than individual maintainers. Solo operator could build a GitHub App that scores PRs for AI-slop likelihood and auto-labels/flags them before human review. Buyer intent is moderate — commercial OSS teams are the strongest prospect. Signal strength kept at 2 because it's a single source and the audience partially overlaps with 'should be free' sentiment.
